chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) to the Syrian questioner, when he asked him: Was our journey to Syria by divine decree and destiny? After a long discourse, this is the selected portion:
ai.seo_question: Was the journey to Syria predestined by Allah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this discourse from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the Syrian questioner to elucidate the nuanced relationship between divine decree (*qada'*) and destiny (*qadar*) during the campaign to Syria. He clarifies that while the event was preordained by Allah, it was not forced upon the believers, thereby affirming the Shia doctrine of *amr bayn al-amrayn* (a position between absolute predestination and total free will). This explanation underscores that human agency operates within the framework of divine will, a key theological distinction in Shia scholarship.
